// Fixed DS-19 non-source witnesses, derived from pinned Test262.
// Foreign source is collected before native emission under ADR 0029.
function testWithTypedArrayConstructors(callback) {
  [Float64Array, Float32Array, Float16Array, Int32Array, Int16Array, Int8Array, Uint32Array, Uint16Array, Uint8Array, Uint8ClampedArray].forEach(callback);
}
function testWithBigIntTypedArrayConstructors(callback) {
  [BigInt64Array, BigUint64Array].forEach(callback);
}
// Replacement for test/built-ins/TypedArrayConstructors/ctors/buffer-arg/proto-from-ctor-realm-sab.js
// Copyright (C) 2016 the V8 project authors. All rights reserved.
// Copyright (C) 2017 Mozilla Corporation. All rights reserved.
// This code is governed by the BSD license found in the LICENSE file.
(function () {
var other = $262.createRealm().global;
var C = other.$262.evalScript("(function(){})");
C.prototype = null;

testWithTypedArrayConstructors(function(TA) {
  var ta = Reflect.construct(TA, [new SharedArrayBuffer(8)], C);

  assert.sameValue(Object.getPrototypeOf(ta), other[TA.name].prototype);
}, null, ["passthrough"]);
})();

(function () {

C.prototype = null;

testWithTypedArrayConstructors(function(TA) {
  var ta = Reflect.construct(TA, [new TA()], C);
